title: Strategy
summary: Swap algorithms behind one interface when the variation is the behavior.

parts.rule: Strategy puts interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface. The context holds a strategy reference and delegates. Adding a new algorithm means a new type without editing the context core flow. Prefer this when behavior varies independently of the object that uses it.
parts.why: Giant switch statements grow brittle as product variants appear. Strategy makes the variation explicit and testable. Overuse invents interfaces for one implementation and hides the real formula behind ceremony.
parts.example: Checkout context calls pricing.strategy.price(cart). Implementations: RegularPricing returns sum of line totals; VipPricing applies ten percent off; CouponPricing subtracts a fixed five dollars when a code is present. Selecting VIP injects VipPricing; the checkout class never sprouts new branches for each campaign. Unit tests construct Checkout with VipPricing and assert totals on a cart of three lines costing 10, 20, and 30. If only RegularPricing will ever exist, delete the interface and call a function. Shipping calculators that are flat, weight-based, or distance-based follow the same shape.  Walk one concrete path with numbers before generalizing. Keep the tone focused and honest. body:
Rule. Strategy puts interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface. The context holds a strategy reference and delegates. Adding a new algorithm means a new type without editing the context core flow. Prefer this when behavior varies independently of the object that uses it.

Why it matters. Giant switch statements grow brittle as product variants appear. Strategy makes the variation explicit and testable. Overuse invents interfaces for one implementation and hides the real formula behind ceremony.

Worked example. Checkout context calls pricing.strategy.price(cart). Implementations: RegularPricing returns sum of line totals; VipPricing applies ten percent off; CouponPricing subtracts a fixed five dollars when a code is present. Selecting VIP injects VipPricing; the checkout class never sprouts new branches for each campaign. Unit tests construct Checkout with VipPricing and assert totals on a cart of three lines costing 10, 20, and 30. If only RegularPricing will ever exist, delete the interface and call a function. Shipping calculators that are flat, weight-based, or distance-based follow the same shape.  Walk one concrete path with numbers before generalizing. Keep the tone focused and honest. When to use. Use strategy for ranking, pricing, compression codecs, and payment authorization flows that swap algorithms. Use it when new variants arrive without changing callers.

When to refuse. Refuse strategy for a one-branch boolean. Refuse a strategy per trivial one-liner that will never multiply. Refuse hiding domain rules so deep that readers cannot find the real formula. Refuse strategy when the varying thing is object lifecycle rather than an algorithm.
